name: deckforge
description: DeckForge monorepo — web (Next.js PWA), mobile (Expo React Native), shared (pure JS libs).
//comment: React 18 is declared here at the root so npm hoists 18 (not mobile's 19) to the top of node_modules/. Web's Next 14 stack needs React 18; mobile's RN 0.81 needs React 19. Without this pin, mobile's 19 wins the hoist and any transitive package that does `require('react')` from root finds 19 — leading to the 'two Reacts' useContext crash during Next prerender. Mobile's React 19 still gets installed locally in mobile/node_modules.
